mapper.select: SELECT u.userCount AS userCount, u.blockedUser AS blockedUser, a.articleCount AS articleCount, a.viewCount AS viewCount, a.likeCount AS likeCount, a.commentCount AS commentCount, a.favoriteCount AS favoriteCount, a.danmakuCount AS danmakuCount, a.pendingExamine AS pendingExamine, o.pendingOpinion AS pendingOpinion FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS userCount, IFNULL(SUM(block_end_time > #{now}), 0) AS blockedUser FROM `user` ) u CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS articleCount, IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS viewCount, IFNULL(SUM(like_count), 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(SUM(comment_count), 0) AS commentCount, IFNULL(SUM(favorite_count), 0) AS favoriteCount, IFNULL(SUM(danmaku_count), 0) AS danmakuCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN examine_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingExamine FROM article WHERE status = #{status} ) a CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS pendingOpinion FROM opinion_table WHERE status = 0 ) o

SELECT a.category AS category, IFNULL(c.name, '') AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS articleCount, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(pv.cnt, 0)), 0) AS periodView, IFNULL(SUM(a.view_count), 0) AS viewCount FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category
WHERE a.status = #{status} GROUP BY a.category, c.name ORDER BY periodView DESC, viewCount DESC
SELECT a.type AS type, COUNT(*) AS articleCount, IFNULL(SUM(a.view_count), 0) AS viewCount FROM article a WHERE a.status = #{status} GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY articleCount DESC

SELECT a.id AS id, a.title AS title, a.img_url AS imgUrl, a.type AS type, a.category AS category, a.user_id AS userId, IFNULL(u.username, '') AS userName, a.create_time AS createTime, a.examine_status AS examineStatus, IFNULL(a.view_count, 0) AS viewCount, IFNULL(a.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(a.comment_count, 0) AS commentCount, IFNULL(a.favorite_count, 0) AS favoriteCount, IFNULL(a.danmaku_count, 0) AS danmakuCount, IFNULL(pv.cnt, 0) AS periodView, IFNULL(pl.cnt, 0) AS periodLike, IFNULL(pc.cnt, 0) AS periodComment FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id
WHERE a.status = #{status} ORDER BY ${orderSql} LIMIT #{limit}
